about: Figures of merit of DESI C_gg alone when the bias parameters are untied per bin, relative to the summary model. Model (fom_model, fom_om_as_model): model B + tilts (notes/higher_order_bias: offsets and counterterms per group with a straight line in redshift, flat priors on the tilts, SN0 and SN2 per group) on the pessimistic linear-bias prior, DESI C_gg alone, against the scale cut k_max [h/Mpc; the z = 0 value of a per-bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i), D the growth factor, by the UV-fraction criterion, alpha = 0.05, within the shipped mask]; null where a cut leaves no fit. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL_B.ipynb. Versions gauss, sqrtn, sqrtn_tilt and nested, each with b1 free per bin (flat prior) and one value per bin of Delta_2, Delta_s, alpha_0, alpha_2, SN0 and SN2: gauss = each per-bin parameter with the width w the model gives its group, no group offsets, no tilts; sqrtn = width w sqrt(N_g), N_g the number of bins of the group in the layout; sqrtn_tilt = the same plus a flat tilt in redshift per group for Delta_2, Delta_s, alpha_0 and alpha_2; nested = per-bin parameters of width w on top of the model's group offsets and tilts; correlated_residuals = the model plus a per-bin residual of Delta_2, Delta_s, alpha_0 and alpha_2 (not SN0, SN2) with a Gaussian prior correlated in redshift, <eps_i eps_j> = w^2 exp(-|zbar_i - zbar_j|/L), L = 0.05, applied as the projected precision that charges only the deviation from the group's line (no residual in a group of one or two bins; b1 on the model's pessimistic prior, unlike the other versions, which free b1 per bin; nested is this idea with L -> 0, no projection and b1 free); constant_per_sample = one value per group of every bias parameter, b1 constant in redshift (not B_g/D(z)), Delta_2, Delta_s, alpha_0, alpha_2, SN0 and SN2, with the model's priors on the group values (b1 flat, the others the model B widths), no tilts and no residuals (b2 and bs2 follow b1 through the calibrations). Per layout, version (model = the summary model itself, and every version above) and score (w0wa, omegam, As_1e9), one value per cut: eta = sqrt(<chi2>/n_dof) and coverage = the probability that the truth falls in the fit's 68.3% region, under the known drifts plus the pessimistic scatter (for constant_per_sample plus the fiducial's own evolution within each sample, b1_i = B_g/D(zbar_i) about a group constant, which a constant cannot follow; every other version holds it in its span, so it is no departure for them); largest_shift = the largest shift over the fixed truths of summary_shifts_kmax [sigma]; evolution_shift = the shift of the evolution alone for constant_per_sample [sigma]. A version with b1 free per bin has eta = 1 and coverage 0.683 by construction. fom and fom_om_as: per version and cut; ratio_fom and ratio_fom_om_as: version / model. FoM(w0, wa) and FoM(Omega_m, 10^9 A_s) are each det(marginalized 2x2 covariance)^(-1/2).
